text:
Julia: Friday pet photo drop! Meet my foster ninja — Cassie, the one-eyed corgi. She stole my slipper this morning and now refuses to give it back. Photo: https://imgur.com/example1 :heart_eyes:
Devon: OMG that face :sob: she looks like a tiny judge of fashion
Olivia: One-eyed corgi? total pirate vibes 🏴‍☠️ name suggestion: Captain Crumbs
Maria: Skipper! or 'Patch' for the one-eye thing :grin: also will she accept office treats?
Leo: Sir Barksalot is a classic. Also low-key jealous my doggos don't steal slippers, they just steal my socks.
Sam: Vote time — 1) Skipper 2) Captain Crumbs 3) Sir Barksalot. React with :one: :two: or :three:
Julia: love these. She already has a tiny bandana so pirate theme fits. Also she does accept treats — especially anything with peanut butter. More pics: https://imgur.com/example2 (1MB)
Devon: adding to wallpaper rotation immediately :desktop_computer:
Olivia: will bring some bully sticks on Monday for Cassie :paw_prints:
Maria: mandatory office visit when she's fully fostered? I volunteer for meet-and-greet shifts
Leo: if she comes to the office i will bring a tiny captain hat. promise.
Sam: caption contest: "When you find out the meeting could've been an email" — winner gets the honor of renaming her for a week :trophy:
Julia: hahaha good one. thanks for all the love, team. Cassie is living her best pirate life right now :parrot:
